lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular lattice of high-luminance circular maxima localized posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a spatial gradient where spot size increases and density decreases along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal interstitial bands of mid-luminance pixels forming a grid, with high-intensity circular blobs anchored at the primary intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-lateral line, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow gradient (high-luminance upper edge, low-luminance lower edge) running from the posterior gill region towards the posterior frame limit.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, transitioning to a more sparse arrangement towards the trailing edge.
